questions.q: How does ADFdi differ from FBDI?
options: ADFdi is an Excel add-in for direct, interactive spreadsheet entry and upload to a Fusion page, while FBDI stages bulk data through an interface table
They are identical mechanisms with different names
ADFdi only works with REST APIs
FBDI is used only for security setup
questions.explain: ADFdi connects a spreadsheet directly to a Fusion page for smaller, interactive data entry, whereas FBDI is a template-driven bulk load through interface tables.

questions.q: What type of error pointed toward a version mismatch rather than a data problem in this ticket?
options: A specific field-level validation rejection
An invalid account combination error
A workbook/integration integrity check failure
A duplicate invoice hold
questions.explain: An integrity check failure on the workbook/integration itself (rather than a specific data field) pointed toward a client/server version mismatch, not a data issue.

questions.q: What was the actual root cause of the ADFdi upload failure?
options: The journal data contained an invalid account
A scheduled environment patch updated the server-side ADFdi version over the weekend, while the accountant's desktop ADFdi add-in was not updated to match
The accountant's workbook was corrupted by a virus
The period was closed
questions.explain: The server-side ADFdi version changed due to a scheduled patch, creating a mismatch with the still-outdated desktop add-in.

questions.q: Why was it recommended to download a fresh copy of the spreadsheet template rather than reuse the old workbook after updating the add-in?
options: The old workbook would upload duplicate data
Fresh templates are required by Oracle licensing
The old workbook had a virus
An old workbook can carry integration metadata tied to the previous ADFdi version
questions.explain: A workbook created under the older ADFdi version can retain metadata tied to that version, so starting from a fresh template avoids residual compatibility issues.

questions.q: What does ADFdi's own validation rule layer do, separate from the version-mismatch issue in this ticket?
options: It catches invalid data, like a bad account combination or missing required field, at the worksheet/table level before it ever reaches the server
Nothing — ADFdi has no validation of its own
It automatically fixes any invalid data
It only validates currency codes
questions.explain: ADFdi enforces its own validation rules locally in the spreadsheet, catching certain invalid data before upload — a different failure mode than a version/integrity mismatch.
